turns.q: How do I use it correctly to get the best result?
turns.replyTail: ge: To help keep your treatment on track, wear your Invisalign® clear aligners about 20–22 hours a day, usually removing them only for eating, brushing, and flossing. Following your doctor’s instructions helps treatment progress as planned. For cleaning, you can use Invisalign™ Cleaning Crystals: rinse the aligners, place them in warm—not hot—water, add one packet, gently agitate for 20 seconds, soak for at least 15 minutes, agitate again for 20 seconds, then rinse thoroughly before reinserting.
